messages.subject: loglocation= "C:/mydata/sleeplog.csv"
parts:
Hi,

I just want to make sure I understand the argument loglocation. It is the location of a speadsheet (csv) with the sleep info reported by the watch user that the GGIR package will use in its analysis to improve the sleep estimations? If this is it, how does it work?

Thank you,

Celia Kingsbury

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: loglocation= "C:/mydata/sleeplog.csv"
parts:
Hi Celia,

Yes, that's correct, loglocaiton refers to the path to a csv with the reported sleep times. You should indicate the column in which your identicator variable is (argument: "colid"), as well as the column that contains the sleep onset hour for the first night (argument: "coln1"). From this column, your csv should include all the sleep onset and waking-up times in this order: sleep onset 1, waking.up time 1, sleep onset 2, waking up time 2,....

You can find an example here: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html#output-part-4 (2.4.5 loglocation)

Hope this helps.

Jairo
